tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from the local filesystem by path.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write or overwrite a file on the local filesystem.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and folders in a directory on the filesystem.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show the working tree status of a git repository.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Stage files and create a git commit with a message in the repository.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show git diff for staged or unstaged changes in the repository.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in a headless browser and wait for the page to load.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element on the current browser page by CSS selector.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web and return ranked result snippets.

tools.name: http_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL over HTTP and return status, headers, and body text.

tools.name: shell_exec
tools.description: Execute a shell command in a working directory and capture stdout/stderr.

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: Store a key-value fact in durable agent memory for later recall.
